name: Smolderstump
look: a stubby, jagged, ash-crusted burnt cigarette with a charred filter base, a collar of grey smoke and ember eyes
entry: Its papery armor has burned away almost entirely, leaving a jagged, ash-crusted torso and a thick collar of acrid gray smoke. It becomes grumpy and sluggish when wet, coughing out choking clouds of soot.
how: Evolve Emberbutt at level 20. It learns Ash Choke when it evolves.
Wild: uncommon in the Ashtray Wastes (an overworld biome added by CobbleEffort: Kanto).
Evolves into Cigarghast when a Dusk Stone is used on it.
